USAGE:
    Cosmos.Patcher.dll patch [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                                 Prints help information          
        --target <TARGET>                      Path to the target assembly      
        --target-platform <TARGET-PLATFORM>    Target platform for the patching 
                                               process                          
        --plugs <PLUGS>                        Plug assemblies, separated by ';'
                                               or ','                           
        --output <OUTPUT>                      Output path for the patched dll  
        --coverage                             Enable plug-map generation for   
                                               coverage tracking

                                DEFAULT

        --assembly-dir <DIR>                     Directory containing assemblies
                                                 to instrument (e.g.            
                                                 obj/.../cosmos/)               
        --output-map <PATH>                      Path to write the coverage map

        --include <PREFIX>      Cosmos.Kernel    Assembly name prefix to include
